content: Delivered: Replaced all 3 bam_aux_get FFI call sites (Record::aux, Record::remove_aux, RecordView::aux) with pure Rust aux_tag_search function. The function performs a linear scan through the BAM aux byte slice, matching the C implementation's semantics exactly. Added raw_aux_data() helper to Record. All 209 tests pass, clippy clean, 8 differential proptests confirm equivalence with C oracle.
